essence: the teacher-lineage is necessary for liberation
mantras are fruitless without an instructor
the guru must know mantra-āgama and keep vow-practice
The guru first arranges matters, then bestows the mantra to his own disciple.
At the end of the body there is eternal liberation, as spoken by Śaṅkara.
